You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0081.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

rw=Chem.RWMol()
coords={}
# Atom name : element, drawing-coordinate
atomdata={
'C10':('C',(575,720)), 'C1':('C',(472,660)), 'C2':('C',(366,720)), 'C3':('C',(366,840)), 'C4':('C',(472,900)), 'C5':('C',(575,840)),
'C6':('C',(682,900)), 'C7':('C',(788,840)), 'C8':('C',(788,720)), 'C9':('C',(682,660)), 'C11':('C',(682,540)), 'C12':('C',(788,480)), 'C13':('C',(895,540)), 'C14':('C',(895,660)),
'C15':('C',(998,478)), 'C16':('C',(1102,538)), 'C17':('C',(1102,660)), 'C18':('C',(998,720)),
'C15a':('C',(998,358)), 'iPr':('C',(895,298)), 'iPrMe1':('C',(895,175)), 'iPrMe2':('C',(788,358)),
'anhydrideC1':('C',(1102,298)), 'anhO':('O',(1208,358)), 'anhydrideC2':('C',(1208,478)), 'anhO1':('O',(1102,220)), 'anhO2':('O',(1310,538)),
'esterC':('C',(1205,600)), 'esterO':('O',(1300,630)), 'esterMe':('C',(1380,690)), 'esterOcarbonyl':('O',(1205,710)),
'acetO':('O',(292,870)), 'acetC':('C',(238,925)), 'acetOcarbonyl':('O',(180,900)), 'acetMe':('C',(185,1000)),
'C10Me':('C',(575,600)), 'C8Me':('C',(788,600)), 'C14Me':('C',(895,780)), 'C4MeA':('C',(420,1015)), 'C4MeB':('C',(515,1015)),
'H_C3':('H',(315,790)), 'H_C9':('H',(682,745)), 'H_C13':('H',(895,455)), 'H_C14':('H',(850,680)), 'H_C10':('H',(620,675)), 'H_C16':('H',(1100,500)),
}
idx={}
for name,(el,xy) in atomdata.items():
    a=Chem.Atom(el)
    idx[name]=rw.AddAtom(a); coords[name]=xy

def bond(a,b,order=Chem.BondType.SINGLE,dir=None):
    rw.AddBond(idx[a],idx[b],order)
    if dir:
        rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(idx[a],idx[b]).SetBondDir(dir)
# fused ring core
for a,b in [('C10','C1'),('C1','C2'),('C2','C3'),('C3','C4'),('C4','C5'),('C5','C10'),
            ('C10','C9'),('C9','C8'),('C8','C7'),('C7','C6'),('C6','C5'),
            ('C9','C11'),('C11','C12'),('C12','C13'),('C13','C14'),('C14','C8'),
            ('C13','C15'),('C15','C16'),('C16','C17'),('C17','C18'),('C18','C14')]:
    bond(a,b)
# unsaturated fused anhydride-like ring
bond('C15','C15a',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
bond('C15a','iPr')
bond('C15a','anhydrideC1')
bond('anhydrideC1','anhO1',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
bond('anhydrideC1','anhO')
bond('anhO','anhydrideC2')
bond('anhydrideC2','anhO2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
bond('anhydrideC2','C16')
# substituents
bond('iPr','iPrMe1'); bond('iPr','iPrMe2')
bond('C16','esterC',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
bond('esterC','esterOcarbonyl',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
bond('esterC','esterO'); bond('esterO','esterMe')
bond('C3','acetO',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
bond('acetO','acetC'); bond('acetC','acetOcarbonyl',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('acetC','acetMe')
bond('C10','C10Me',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
bond('C8','C8Me',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
bond('C14','C14Me',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
bond('C4','C4MeA',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH); bond('C4','C4MeB',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
# explicitly depicted hydrogens at stereocenters
bond('C3','H_C3')
bond('C9','H_C9',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
bond('C13','H_C13',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
bond('C14','H_C14')
bond('C10','H_C10')
bond('C16','H_C16')

mol=rw.GetMol()
# sanitize then add 2D conformer to help resolve wedge directions
Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
conf=Chem.Conformer(mol.GetNumAtoms())
for name,i in idx.items():
    x,y=coords[name]
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(float(x),float(-y),0.0))
mol.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(mol, replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('centers preH',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol,includeUnassigned=True,includeCIP=True))
print('smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(mol,isomericSmiles=True))
# preserve drawing assigned stereochemistry; explicit H atoms already present, add implicit Hs
mol=Chem.AddHs(mol, addCoords=False)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=8081; params.useRandomCoords=True
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol,params)
print('embed status',status,'atoms',mol.GetNumAtoms())
if status<0:
    params.useRandomCoords=False
    status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol,params)
print('second',status)
if status==0:
    mp=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mol)
    if mp:
        ff=AllChem.MMFFGetForceField(mol,mp); ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000); print('MMFF energy',ff.CalcEnergy())
    else:
        AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(mol,maxIters=1000)
    print('centers final',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(Chem.RemoveHs(mol),includeUnassigned=True,includeCIP=True))
    conf=mol.GetConformer()
    with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
        f.write(f'{mol.GetNumAtoms()}\n')
        f.write('3D structure generated from mol_0081.png\n')
        for a in mol.GetAtoms():
            p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
            f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
PY
